Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk

Interface AGUIAgent

All Superinterfaces:
LG4JLoggable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AGUIAgentBase
public interface AGUIAgent extends LG4JLoggable
Represents an agent compliant with the AG-UI protocol, capable of running against a RunAgentInput and streaming back a reactive sequence of Events.

Implementations are expected to bridge a langgraph4j graph (or any other execution engine) to the AG-UI event model, exposing a unique identifier and an asynchronous execution entry point.

  • Method Details

    • id

      String id()
      Returns the unique identifier of this agent. it will be referenced in the AG-UI protocol to distinguish between different agents and their runs.
      Returns:
      the agent id

    • run

      Flow.Publisher<? extends com.agui.community.core.event.Event> run(com.agui.community.core.agent.RunAgentInput input)
      Runs the agent with the given input and returns a Flow.Publisher that emits the resulting AG-UI Events as they are produced.
      Parameters:
      input - the input describing the run to execute (e.g. thread id, messages, state, tools)
      Returns:
      a publisher streaming the events generated during the run
